records.text: The U.S. Army missed warning signs that civilian commander David Frodsham led a child-pornography ring and endangered U.S. security.
records.speaker: CBS News

appearances.snippet: And I'm showing you this article from CBS News. U.S. Army missed the red flags about a civilian leader. who led a child porn ring and risked U.S. security. That person's name was David Frodsham.

verification.notes: CBS/AP reporting based on Army investigative records confirms that the Army missed red flags, Frodsham led a child-sex-abuse ring, pleaded guilty, and posed a counterintelligence risk.
